research_rationale: The complete held original establishes an advisory committee, committee-only functions and support, a FACA delegation, and an original December 31, 1984 sunset. EO:12497 replaces that sunset with September 30, 1985; EO:12533 extends to December 31, 1986 and separately changes membership; EO:12579 extends to December 31, 1987; EO:12617 replaces the sunset with 60 days after actual report submission or no later than September 30, 1988, unless extended. None of these amendments is a whole-order cessation. The dossier lacks the actual report submission date, so the conditional earliest end cannot be fixed. EO:12692 section 3(a) later formally revokes the order, and section 5 states September 30, 1989, rather than its September 29 signing date. That formal revocation cannot displace the earlier termination question and its flagged official images remain unchecked. Original section 2(c) is only a nine-month report deadline. No current-law historical snapshot supplies a missing date or a 2026 predicate.
